design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — warranty_rework_desk task 1 (Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty: same-visit courtesy on two parts diagnostic charges).

[Step 0 — draw] `draw_counts.py <diff> --task 1` printed {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 6, 4, 5]}. Assignment: same-visit courtesy (warranty_ext_same_visit_courtesy) 6, electrical diagnostic charge (warranty_ext_electrical_diagnostic_charge) 5, mechanical diagnostic charge (warranty_ext_mechanical_diagnostic_charge) 4, rework courtesy rental days (warranty_ext_rework_courtesy_rental) 5. Three prerequisite problems; all three edges are value_input (floor max(3-1,1) = 2).

[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: warranty_ext_calibration_diagnostic_charge and warranty_ext_calibration_goodwill with tools accept_calibration_diagnostic_charge_d9578b72 and grant_calibration_goodwill_f9a2e5bf (calibration coverages only). Claimed here: warranty_ext_electrical_diagnostic_charge/accept_electrical_diagnostic_charge_607d2bcb, warranty_ext_mechanical_diagnostic_charge/accept_mechanical_diagnostic_charge_d69f0d58, warranty_ext_rework_courtesy_rental/sign_rework_authorization_70486d76, warranty_ext_same_visit_courtesy/book_same_visit_courtesy_9d7b5f0e — the parts side of the desk on collision and structural coverages. Union = all six extended policies; scopes and tools are disjoint. Last task: no headroom to reserve.

[Why this is a good test] The customer asks only whether anything can be done about two inspection fees. The charter answers with the same-visit courtesy, but its rule says it is not worked out until the electrical charge stands, figured only after the mechanical charge stands, and booked only once the visit's covered concern carries its network rework authorization. The records show none of the three. The agent must find each resolving write (two customer acceptances and the customer's rework signature), compute five-, four- and five-factor amounts for them from the source repair, the calibration and rental desks' ledgers and the coverage's rework history, then compute a six-factor courtesy on the world those writes leave, and pick the larger charge to book it against. Long (three hops into the root) and broad (retail, estimate, adas and rental records, three history windows).

[Problem-tree card] root warranty_ext_same_visit_courtesy (state_due). Edges, all form state, all value_input:
 E1 warranty_ext_same_visit_courtesy -> warranty_ext_electrical_diagnostic_charge, gate visit_charges. Sentence: "The same-visit courtesy is not worked out until the electrical diagnostic charge owed on every not-covered electrical-part finding of the visit stands on the coverage's account." (negated direction: a booking result stated as 'not ... until'). False at the opening: concern 3 inspected not_covered (40d04e22-06b7-485a-a976-1e999d084a5d), ledger empty. Resolved by accept_electrical_diagnostic_charge_607d2bcb (owner user). Exactly one write of the difficulty books an electrical diagnostic charge.
 E2 warranty_ext_same_visit_courtesy -> warranty_ext_mechanical_diagnostic_charge, gate visit_charges. Sentence: "The same-visit courtesy is figured only after the mechanical diagnostic charge owed on every not-covered mechanical-part finding of the visit stands on the coverage's account." (affirmative 'only after'). False: concern 4 not_covered (6060989b-7e86-4cee-8ad0-06767840e791), no charge. Resolved by accept_mechanical_diagnostic_charge_d69f0d58 (owner user); only write that books a mechanical diagnostic charge.
 E3 warranty_ext_same_visit_courtesy -> warranty_ext_rework_courtesy_rental, gate courtesy_share. Sentence: "The same-visit courtesy is booked only once the covered concern found at the visit carries its network rework authorization." ('only once'). False: concern 2 inspected covered (f65b38cf-29d6-4c2c-8b87-5eb95256493b) with no authorization (the two authorizations a45597d1-fae9-4015-b0d7-041997a0d3c5, 2a592767-c2c6-4d7f-9e59-cf6602a983a5 are concern 1). Resolved by sign_rework_authorization_70486d76 (owner user); the only tool that records a network rework authorization.
 Four-point test on each: ordering connective present; the waited-on side is a record-visible state; no tool/id/code token; scope exact (every not-covered finding of that kind at the visit; the visit's covered concern). Derivation: sentence + records + the depended-on rule ('posts one electrical/mechanical diagnostic charge for that concern'; 'A covered concern whose remedy is a network rework ... is recorded with the rework courtesy rental days') -> one resolving action each.
 Topological order warranty_ext_electrical_diagnostic_charge, warranty_ext_mechanical_diagnostic_charge, warranty_ext_rework_courtesy_rental, warranty_ext_same_visit_courtesy; the three prerequisites commute (all six permutations give terminal hash 33f588e0ae5e...). Skip runs: without the electrical charge 21.00, without the mechanical charge 25.00, without the authorization 25.00 (gold 32.00). user_scenario never mentions the door gap, the charges' booking or any order; tools validate nothing (ctx.create only).

[Base-invariant card] Charges: warranty_evt_diagnostic_fee, no gate on warranty_charge (policy_scope); amount clause superseded per part kind by the extended charge rules (declared overwrite); fee-bearing scope kept (mechanical_part and electrical_part are the Collision plan's fee types). Rework authorization: warranty_evt_rework gate concern_covered 'The inspection of that concern determined it covered.' — inspection f65b38cf-29d6-4c2c-8b87-5eb95256493b (coverage 3e2bf0f5-a25f-445f-bd4b-279f85c47a0e, concern 2, covered) binds warranty_coverage_id and concern_number; escalation clause not reached (one not-resolved attempt, on concern 1); the courtesy clause 'when the target exceeds courtesy_rental_min_rework_days the network pays a courtesy rental of up to courtesy_rental_days days' superseded by the courtesy-day rule (declared overwrite); the rework tool records calibration_needed false, which suits a right-rear door-gap realignment (no record places a sensor on that door; the blind-spot radar calibrated on order 6cebbd8b-ccaf-4baf-aa01-ec7af56bcaa1 belongs to the original repair), so no calibration order is triggered; a rework that disturbs a sensor would need a recalibration this task's tool does not record. Courtesy: warranty_evt_diagnostic_fee gate charge_open bound to the electrical charge booked at step 13 (open); cap: plan goodwill authority 45.00 kept. No time gate on these writes; the concerns were reported 2 days after discovery (inside 30).

[Business-object card] Coverage 3e2bf0f5-a25f-445f-bd4b-279f85c47a0e on Customer-Pay Collision Service 3dfde060-0c00-40d3-95fc-5987c70932a3 (booking ffa3967f-f422-41ad-b711-b044e3040604, calibration order 6cebbd8b-ccaf-4baf-aa01-ec7af56bcaa1, rental 61a06298-9e3c-4d6b-aea9-b1ea5ed3a131). Charges keyed (coverage, concern 3) and (coverage, concern 4); rework keyed (coverage, concern 2, attempt 1); courtesy keyed source_entry_id = the larger charge wle_28c97158ee29. Excluded: concern 1 (resolved, its two authorizations and completions are history evidence only); the rental's discount credit (reduces money, not days).

[Factor cards] baselines: charges 'the plan's standard diagnostic fee, charged in full once' (89.95 each); courtesy days 'the plan's courtesy rental days, counted one rental day for each' (3); courtesy 'the standard courtesy share of the parts diagnostic charges booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before' (153.86 x 0.05 = 7.69).
 Electrical (5): repair-size fee 109.95 (28.5 h; baseline 79.91) | sensor-network fee 29.95 (calibration completed in-house, both conditions read from that one order; cross-difficulty adas; baseline 64.96) | shared-visit rate x0.75 (two not-covered findings on 2026-10-07; method; baseline 122.40) | part-age credit 5.00 (8 months past; baseline 99.91) | comeback credit 12.50 (one not-resolved rework; near-miss: the resolved rework does not count; baseline 107.41). -> 94.91.
 Mechanical (4): road-test fee 109.95 (24,578 miles >= 2 x 12,000; baseline 48.95) | lift-access fee 19.95 (Customer-Pay Collision; baseline 39.00) | return-visit rate halve-and-floor (resolved rework 2026-09-17 < 1 month; method; near-miss: the July not-resolved completion does not count; baseline 114.90) | multi-service credit 15.00 (multi-source calibration payment AND rental payment, cross-difficulty rental; baseline 73.95). -> 58.95.
 Courtesy days (5): allowance counting (method: 3 x 1.4 rounded up = 5; baseline 7) | comeback 1 (baseline 8) | refinish 1 (multi-source: panel_fit being reworked AND a paint concern on the coverage; baseline 8) | source-repair 1 (9 days drop-off to ready; baseline 8) | paid-rental 1 (9 uncovered days; cross-difficulty rental; baseline 8). -> 9. The seeded July and September authorizations carry 7 and 8 days, exactly what this rule gave on those dates.
 Courtesy (6): share 0.08 (multi-source: one covered finding that day AND 9 courtesy days on its rework; baseline 25.00) | estimate allowance 3.00 (cross-difficulty estimate 6,450; baseline 28.00) | covered-history 2.00 (baseline 29.00) | coverage-age 3.00 (20 months; baseline 28.00) | low-use 2.00 (baseline 29.00) | comeback adjustment x1.4 rounded up (two reworks completed in 12 months; method; baseline 22.31). -> 32.00 (< 45).

[World rows] customer, vehicle (owned), estimate booking (estimate total), customer-pay repair (labor hours, service, dates), calibration order + charge + customer payment, rental + uncovered-days charge + discount credit + payment, coverage, 12 concern events. Every row is read by a gold finder and feeds a factor or a gate; dropping the rental payment flips the multi-service credit to 7.50 (charge 66.45); dropping the July not-resolved completion changes three of the four results — electrical 107.41 (no comeback credit), courtesy days 8 (no comeback day) and, on that electrical charge, the courtesy 26.81 (166.36 x 0.08 + 10.00 = 23.3088, one completion in 12 months -> x1.15 = 26.81) — while the mechanical charge stays 58.95, because its return-visit rate reads only resolved completions. Automatic clauses: lifetime coverage, vehicle owned, no void; concern 1 has one failure (no escalation); no other policy lit (no calibration coverage, so calibration goodwill does not apply).

[Persona] Derek Whitfield, deliberate electrician. Volunteers only the request and what the inspector told him (lock motor and check strap not covered, diagnostic fees) — both in the records (40d04e22-06b7-485a-a976-1e999d084a5d, 6060989b-7e86-4cee-8ad0-06767840e791). Asked-only: name, phone 3035550582, PIN 5741, email, ZIP, vehicle, center preference, loaner, timing. Passive: agrees to the fees being booked, accepts each when handed, takes up the door-gap rework only if the agent raises it, signs with the agent's values, ends on hearing the reduction.

[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify -> vehicles -> coverages -> events -> ledger -> retail repairs -> estimate bookings -> adas orders -> adas ledger -> rentals -> rental ledger -> customer accepts electrical charge 94.91 (concern 3) -> customer accepts mechanical charge 58.95 (concern 4) -> customer signs rework (concern 2, attempt 1, AUR-0207, 9 days) -> agent books courtesy 32.00 against wle_28c97158ee29.

[Verification code] A throwaway authoring script (kept outside env/ and deleted after authoring; check_compute.py reproduces every figure below from the published charter) replayed gold with the real tools and evaluates compute at each handling time: electrical 94.91 (factor baselines 79.91/64.96/122.4/99.91/107.41, all 89.95); mechanical 58.95 (48.95/39.0/114.9/73.95, all 89.95); days 9 (7/8/8/8/8, all 3); courtesy 32.0 (25/28/29/28/29/22.31, all 7.69). Skip runs 21/25/25. Permutation run: one terminal hash for all six orders.

[Revisions] (1) Ceiling was first written as -int(-x), which truncates (4.2 -> 4); courtesy days came out 8 and the courtesy 31 -> replaced by int(x) + (1 if x > int(x) else 0) in all three policies using 'rounded up'; re-run gave 9 and 32.00; seeded historical courtesy days (7, 8) re-checked against the corrected rule. (2) The source repair was first an insurance claim repair; its insurer profile would be an unread parent -> switched to a customer-pay repair with its estimate booking, which a factor now reads.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] From the published rules, finder returns and persona alone: the courtesy rule's three sentences point at the two missing charges and the missing authorization; each amount recomputes to 94.91, 58.95 and 9 days; the courtesy recomputes to 32.00 against the larger (electrical) charge. Same as gold.

[Revisions — round 2, policy audit] T1-1 (false proof assertion): the [World rows] sentence claimed that dropping the July not-resolved completion changes all four results; recomputation gives electrical 107.41, courtesy days 8, courtesy 26.81 and an unchanged mechanical 58.95 -> sentence rewritten to those figures. F-1 (charter): the four rules that counted 'network reworks' while compute counts every completion now say 'remedy attempts ..., network reworks and outside-shop repairs alike'; both completions on this coverage are network reworks, so no value moves (94.91 / 58.95 / 9 / 32.00); factor traces and tiers re-worded. O-3: the courtesy-day rule's gate (target days above the minimum, else none) now has its compute branch; true here (5 > 1). O-5b: the rework edge's condition no longer adds 'courtesy_rental_days above zero'. O-11: the charge rules' replacement sentences restate that every other inspection stays free. T1-O4: the sensor-network fee is no longer called multi-source. T1-O6: the customer's calibration payment is dated on the order's completion date 2025-01-14 (adas settlement: paid on completion); the 36-month count is unchanged. T1-O3: the calibration_needed sentence now states only what the records support.
user_scenario: You are Derek Whitfield, a fifty-eight-year-old commercial electrician from Aurora, Colorado. In January 2025 Crestline repaired the right rear door and quarter panel of your 2021 Ford Explorer after a parking-lot hit, and you paid for that repair yourself. On October 7th a Crestline inspector looked over some problems on that side of the car, and he told you that the power lock motor in the right rear door and the door's check strap are no longer covered because too much time has passed since the repair, and that there would be diagnostic fees for checking them. You are calling because you'd like to know if there is anything Crestline can do about those inspection fees. You speak in a calm, deliberate way, you like the agent to tell you plainly what they are doing, and you do not like to be rushed. You do not know how Crestline works out its fees or reductions and you never quote an amount; if asked, you say the inspector did not give you figures. When the agent asks who you are, you give your name, Derek Whitfield, and the phone number on your account, 3035550582; if a second detail is needed you give your account PIN, 5741. You give your email (derek.whitfield@outlook.com) or ZIP code (80015) only if the agent asks for one of those specifically. If asked about the vehicle, it is the 2021 Ford Explorer Crestline repaired in January 2025. You do not bring up anything else from the inspection unless the agent does. If the agent explains that the inspection fees have to be on your account first and asks whether that is all right, you say that is fine. Each time the agent hands you a step to accept one of those fees, you accept it exactly as the agent describes it, with the coverage, the concern and the amount the agent gives you. If the agent brings up the door-gap repair the inspector found covered, you say you would like that taken care of, that the same center that inspected the car last week is fine, and that you would gladly take a loaner while it is in the shop; when the agent hands you the step to sign that rework authorization, you sign it exactly as the agent describes it, with the concern, the attempt, the center and the loaner days the agent gives you. If asked when you can bring the car in, you say as soon as they can fit it in and that the center can call you with a date. Once the agent tells you what reduction has been applied to the fees, you thank them, say that is fair, and end the call. If the agent tells you nothing can be reduced, you accept that and end the call. You do not ask to pay anything today and you do not ask for anything else.
